protocol.purpose: Statistical comparison only, no model training or validated emergency rule

selection.eligibility: Earliest 28 consecutive original calendar dates with >=130/144 valid environmental slots on every date, using existing EDA definition
selection.baseline: First 14 dates only; no validation activity or alert outcomes used for type or ID selection
selection.calibration_quality: At least 10 valid baseline days for each of four 1-hour morning windows
selection.tie_break: First pseudonymous ID not already assigned; preserve overlaps and report absence if no unused eligible ID

type_rules.아침 활동형: median daily 07:00-11:00 positive-slot ratio >=0.50 AND morning median minus all-day median >=0.10
type_rules.오전 저활동형: morning median <=0.25 AND 12:00-18:00 median >=0.40 AND afternoon minus morning >=0.20
type_rules.온습도 변화형: range of baseline daily mean Temperature >=3 degC OR range of baseline daily mean Humidity >=15 RH percentage points

morning_rule.metric: R = number of observed Activity_IR >0 slots / number of valid Activity_IR slots
morning_rule.quality: R requires >=90% of 6 expected slots, missing run <=2 slots, and last expected slot valid; >=90% implies all six slots for this window
morning_rule.candidate: R < threshold AND longest observed consecutive Activity_IR ==0 run >=3 slots (30 minutes); missing breaks zero run
morning_rule.threshold_common: 0.5 * median across calibration-eligible households whose baseline ends no later than the earliest selected baseline end, of each household's median baseline R, separately for each window; equal household weighting; no common-reference data later than selected follow-up start
morning_rule.threshold_personal: 0.5 * selected household's median baseline R, separately for each window
morning_rule.zero_threshold_policy: Preserve zero, no floor. Strict R<0 cannot trigger; mark limitation rather than invent sensitivity
morning_rule.counts: Both candidate windows and unique candidate days; first occurrence per candidate date plus all times retained

compound_rule.window: Same four one-hour morning windows and evaluation times
compound_rule.candidate: same morning activity candidate AND Temperature >=30 degC in all 6 expected valid slots
compound_rule.quality: Temperature finite and -40..85, all six expected temperature slots present; otherwise unverifiable; common and personal use identical temperature condition
compound_rule.interpretation: Six samples treated as six 10-minute slots; continuous high temperature between samples is not established; not heat illness diagnosis

protocol.time_zone: Original naive timestamps only; KST not confirmed
protocol.sensor: Activity_IR is au; >0 is research proxy, not PIR ON/OFF
protocol.representative_case: 아침 활동형 if available, else first available type in fixed order; independent of validation outcomes or alert reduction
